skills.description: Skill ids attached to this agent.

tools.description: Tool names this agent may use (see `tool.list`). Empty = read-only.

maxTokens.description: Rough prompt tokens across the run; 1 000–500 000.

note.description: Final summary, question for the user, or why it stopped.

agentId.description: Omit for a one-off task with default limits ("Do it" in the composer).

AnimationLevel.description: How lively the buddy's motion is. Reduced Motion in macOS always wins.

Annotation.description: One drawing on the guidance overlay.

oneOf.description: Tinted box with a glowing edge.
Dims everything except the rectangle.
A pulsing cursor indicator at a point.

ApprovalRequest.description: The assistant wants to do something and needs the user's OK (spec §58).

choices.description: The choices offered (riskier actions offer fewer).

detail.description: Plain-language detail, e.g. which app and where.

riskReason.description: Why it's this risky, when it was raised above the tool's default.

AssistantState.description: Everything the assistant can be doing, shown on the buddy and in the panel (spec §28, §92).

oneOf.description: Resting beside the pointer.
Summoned and attentive; tracks the pointer closely.

expanded.description: Whether the assistant panel is expanded from the buddy.

AudioChunk.description: 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit PCM, base64, ~100 ms per chunk (host → core).

AxContext.description: Model-ready accessibility context: the few elements that matter, plus a compact text form.

summary.description: One line per element, e.g. `button "Submit" at (820,440) 120×32`.

AxNode.description: One normalized accessibility element. Secure text field values are never populated.

nodes.description: Elements inside the requested region (bounded traversal).

truncated.description: Traversal hit its node or time budget.

point.description: Element under this point (global points). Defaults to the pointer.

ChannelState.description: Whether each invocation channel is actually live right now — never assumed.

Citation.description: A source an answer drew on (shown under the answer).

ComputerSettings.description: Computer control (spec §55–58). Off until the user turns it on.

confirmEveryAction.description: Ask before every action, even ones allowed for the session or always.

oneOf.description: The shortcut will not work (taken by macOS or another app).
It works, but shadows a common shortcut.

ContextInfo.description: What context an answer was given (spec §36, §97) — shown under the answer.

files.description: Passages from your files included, as citation labels.

imageBytes.description: Size of the compressed screenshot sent, if any.

reusedScreen.description: The screen from an earlier question was reused (no new capture or vision pass).

summarizedMessages.description: Older messages condensed into a short summary to fit the model's context.

textOnlyReason.description: Why the screenshot wasn't sent even though one was attached.

CursorPreviewParams.description: Play the given states on the real on-screen buddy, for previewing themes.

oneOf.description: Wisp's glossy 3D arrowhead.
A classic pointer arrow.
A glowing dot.

CursorVisibility.description: When the buddy is on screen.

oneOf.description: Always beside the pointer; click it to open the assistant.
Only while the assistant is summoned.

frame.description: Display frame in global points (top-left origin).

vectors.description: One per text; empty when a text couldn't be embedded.

Empty.description: Parameters for methods that take none. Accepts `{}` or an absent/`null` params field.

EndpointConfig.description:
A user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, llama.cpp server, or a cloud API).
Its API key lives in the Keychain under `keychain_account`, never here.

ExtractedText.description: Text the host read from a rich file, one entry per page (PDF) or a single entry.

paged.description: True when pages are real PDF pages (for "page N" citations).

FileImportData.description: A dropped file's bytes (drag and drop), base64.

FocusAttachment.description: What the user was pointing at when they asked. Metadata only; the image stays in the cache.

FocusImage.description: A captured image of the focused area. Kept only in Wisp's cache; never logged.

oneOf.description: The area around a single clicked point.
Freeform loop drawn around the target.
The frontmost window under the pointer.
The whole display under the pointer.

FocusRegion.description: What the user pointed the assistant at (spec §34).

accessibility.description: Relevant UI elements in the region, when Accessibility is allowed.

crop.description: What was captured: the selection plus margin, clipped to the display, global points.

path.description: Lasso path or clicked point, global points.

selection.description: What the user selected, global points.

text.description: Text recognized on screen inside the capture (Apple Vision, on device).

dimSurroundings.description: Dim everything outside the selection while drawing.

margin.description: Context kept around a selection, in points (0–200).

pointSize.description: Side of the square captured around a point focus, in points (120–1200).

GlowMode.description: How the buddy's glow is colored.

oneOf.description: Glow in the cursor's color.
Glow blends from `glowFrom` to `glowTo`.

buddyTarget.description: Where the buddy flies to point (it returns to the pointer afterwards).

durationMs.description: Auto-dismiss after this long; Esc, a click or the next invocation dismiss sooner.

GuidanceTarget.description: Something on screen an answer pointed at, resolved to where it is.

key.description: A letter, digit or named key.

InvocationAction.description: Action bound to a secondary invocation source.

oneOf.description: Same as the keyboard shortcut in toggle mode.
Assistant cursor appears ready to point or draw.

InvocationBehavior.description: What holding / pressing the shortcut does (spec §18).

oneOf.description: Active while held; releasing finishes the interaction.
A press turns the assistant on; the next press turns it off.
Listening while held; releasing sends what you said. Requires voice.
A quick press-and-release in hold mode (opens or closes the assistant panel).

holdDelayMs.description: Delay before a held modifier-only chord activates, so ⌘⌥-key app shortcuts don't flash Wisp.

eventTapPermitted.description: Accessibility (or Input Monitoring) granted — required for modifier-only chords and mouse buttons.

key.description:
A named key: return, tab, escape, space, delete, forwardDelete, up, down, left, right,
home, end, pageUp, pageDown, f1–f12.

watching.description: Whether Wisp can notice on its own that a step was done (needs Accessibility).

oneOf.description: "I did it" — look again and continue.
Highlight and say the current step again.
Looking at the screen and working out the next step.
Waiting for the user to do the current step.
It couldn't work out how to continue; the user can say more or stop.

confirmed.description: How the step was confirmed, e.g. "The window changed".

messageId.description: The assistant message that holds this step.

oneOf.description: Forgotten after a day.
Forgotten when Wisp restarts.

query.description: Filter by words in the content.

MemoryRef.description: A memory saved or used by an answer (shown in the chat).

learnFromChats.description: Save things the user clearly states ("remember that…", "I prefer…").

oneOf.description: Added or edited by the user on the Memory page.
Taken from something the user said ("remember that…").
Saved by an agent.

citations.description: Your files this answer drew on ([n] in the text).

context.description: What was sent to the model with this answer's question (privacy transparency).

guidance.description: Things on screen this answer pointed at (shown with the guidance overlay).

reasoning.description: The model's streamed reasoning, shown collapsed above the answer.

reasoningMs.description: How long the model reasoned before answering.

savedMemories.description: Memories saved from the question this answers (shown with Undo).

stage.description: What's happening right now while `status` is `streaming` (live progress for the UI).

MessageStage.description: Live progress of an answer, so the UI can say what Wisp is doing instead of a bare spinner.

oneOf.description: Gathering the conversation and attachments.
Reading the attached screen region (image + UI elements).
Picking the model to use.
The chosen model isn't in memory yet and is loading.
The model is working on it (no output yet).
The model is streaming its reasoning.
The answer is streaming.

general.description: Preferred model for text. `None` lets the router choose.

vision.description: Preferred model when an image (focus region) is included.

Modifier.description: Modifier keys, in canonical display order (⌃ ⌥ ⇧ ⌘ fn).

MouseButton.description: Mouse buttons macOS reports to event taps. Primary/secondary buttons are never bindable.

label.description:
What's there, e.g. "Save" — shown in approvals, used to press the element directly and
to judge risk.

oneOf.description: Nothing leaves the Mac. Cloud providers are never eligible, including as fallback.
Local whenever possible; ask before each cloud use.
Configured cloud providers may be used.

ProviderState.description: Provider health as observed right now (spec §111). Never assumed.

oneOf.description: Ready to answer.
Installed but its server isn't running.
Not installed on this Mac.
Present but unusable (e.g. Apple Intelligence off, unreachable endpoint).

reason.description: Why this model was chosen, in plain words.

allowCloud.description: The user approved cloud use for this one request (Local Preferred).

agentId.description: Run this agent with the prompt as its goal; otherwise the prompt is answered as a question.

scheduleText.description: Plain description of the schedule, e.g. "Weekdays at 09:00".

conversationId.description: The conversation holding the answer (prompt routines).

oneOf.description: Keep going after being stuck.

reply.description: Reply to a question the agent asked (with Continue).

oneOf.description: Waiting for the user to approve an action.
Repeated itself or hit a dead end; Continue or Stop.
Asked the user a question.

ScreenText.description:
On-screen text, read on device. Lets text-only models understand the screen and lets
guidance find targets by their label.

lines.description: Reading order: top to bottom, left to right.

act.description: Carry out this goal on the computer as an agent run instead of answering (spec §60).

allowCloud.description: The user approved cloud for this message (Local Preferred).

conversationId.description: Continue this conversation; omit to start a new one.

includeFocus.description: Attach the current focus region (screenshot + UI elements).

model.description: Use this model instead of the router's choice.

teach.description: Start a guided lesson for this goal instead of answering (spec §53).

SettingsPane.description: System Settings panes Wisp may open for the user.

Shortcut.description: A global shortcut: modifiers plus an optional key. No key means a modifier-only chord (⌘⌥).

keyCode.description: macOS virtual key code (`kVK_*`), absent for modifier-only chords.

keyLabel.description: Human-readable key label captured at record time, e.g. "Space", "K".

with.description: What it conflicts with, e.g. "Spotlight", "Copy (most apps)".

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long (1–30 s).

oneOf.description: Speak answers to spoken questions.

SpeechChunk.description: A synthesized piece of speech ready to play (core → host). `path` is inside Wisp's cache.

StagedFile.description: Files the host copied into Wisp's data folder after the user picked them.

path.description: Relative to the data folder (always under `files/`).

oneOf.description: Matched a UI element from Accessibility (exact frame).
Matched text read on screen.
Coordinates given by a vision model.

frame.description: Global points (top-left origin), like every other screen coordinate.

ToolCall.description: Every action Wisp can take on the computer.

oneOf.description: Describe the frontmost window's controls (read-only).
Find a control by its label (read-only).

ToolCallRecord.description: One audited tool call (spec §105: no private content — arguments are summarized).

decision.description: allowOnce | allowSession | alwaysAllow | deny | policyDeny | autoAllow | granted

ToolDefinition.description: What a tool is and how risky it is by default (for UIs and agents).

ToolExecution.description: What the host reports after performing an action.

output.description: Text result for read-only tools (clipboard, screen description).

ToolGrant.description: A standing "always allow" or "never allow" for a tool.

session.description: Tools allowed for the rest of this session.

messageId.description: The answer this action came from, if any.

ToolRunResult.description: Result of `tool.run`: the audit record plus any text output.

oneOf.description: Nothing observable either way (spec §62: never assume success).

VoiceAsked.description: Host → UI: a spoken question was asked in this conversation.

includeFocus.description: Ask about the current focus region too.

transcribeOnly.description: Transcribe only (microphone test) — don't ask anything.

VoiceLevel.description: Host → UI: microphone level 0–1 while listening.
